title: NS Client loosing connection
body: NS Client saying destroy and afterwards not allowed until the App is stopped and restart. It happens every few minutes. Updated to 2.7 shortly. With 2.614 no issues. Checked already the server, seems its normal. Tested on 13, 1405 and 1406, all the same. Got some socket errors before. Any idea ?

comments.body: Seems that on a mobile we have to switch off wlan first to get an allowed message on mobile connetion.
